import z3

# Social Golfers: 24 golfers, 8 groups of 3, 8 weeks
# No pair together more than once

weeks = 8
golfers = 24
groups = 8
group_size = 3

# Create solver
s = z3.Solver()

# Variables: group[w][p] = group of player p in week w, 0 to 7
group = [[z3.Int(f'g{w}_{p}') for p in range(golfers)] for w in range(weeks)]

# Constraints
for w in range(weeks):
    for p in range(golfers):
        s.add(group[w][p] >= 0, group[w][p] < groups)
    
    # Exactly 3 per group
    for g in range(groups):
        s.add(z3.Sum([z3.If(group[w][p] == g, 1, 0) for p in range(golfers)]) == group_size)

# Pair constraints: any two players together in at most one week
for p1 in range(golfers):
    for p2 in range(p1+1, golfers):
        together = []
        for w in range(weeks):
            together.append(z3.If(group[w][p1] == group[w][p2], 1, 0))
        s.add(z3.Sum(together) <= 1)

print(s.check())
